Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+ recommended)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Hat and sunglasses
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Evening attire (for the Luau experience)
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Waterproof phone case
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Medications
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Cash and credit cards
